name: bookmark-preview-vault
description: Firefox sidebar extension: visual bookmark previews with an encrypted private space

scripts.build: npm run clean && vite build && vite build --config vite.config.background.ts
scripts.watch: npm run clean && (vite build --watch & vite build --config vite.config.background.ts --watch & wait)
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run package && npm run lint:ext
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist --overwrite-dest --filename bookmark-preview-vault-{version}.zip
